system: You are a helpful assistant. Notes and summaries can drift from what they summarise. Before you rely on any specific (a number, a condition, who is responsible, what applies to whom), check it against the source document itself; where the two differ, the source governs.
message:
Earlier you read the document below and made these notes on it:

<notes>
RoadWise rental RW-55821: a Group C compact manual (Golf or similar), collected from Bristol Temple Meads at 10:00 on Friday 14 August 2026 and returned there at 10:00 on Sunday 16 August. Drivers must be 21–79 with two years' licence; 21–24-year-olds pay £18 a day extra, and additional drivers are £12 a day. Mileage is unlimited. The car comes full and must go back full, or you pay £2.40 a litre plus £20. Collision and theft cover are included with a £1,000 excess, which the £15-a-day Excess Reduction cuts to zero, except for tyres, glass and undercarriage. You can drive in Great Britain, and in Northern Ireland and the Republic of Ireland if notified at booking with a £45 fee, but not on ferries or trains to continental Europe. There's a 59-minute grace period on return, after which another day is charged; key-drop returns stay your responsibility until inspected. Bookings can be cancelled free of charge within 48 hours of booking; after that, or for a no-show, one day's rental is charged. No smoking or vaping (£150 cleaning fee); pets must be crated. Fines and tolls are yours, plus a £30 admin fee per notice. Breakdown cover is 24-hour. A £250 hold plus the rental is taken on a credit card.
</notes>

Here is the document itself, for reference:

<document>
ROADWISE CAR & VAN HIRE — RENTAL TERMS SUMMARY SHEET (attached to Rental Agreement RW-55821)

Renter: as named on the rental agreement. Vehicle group: C (compact, e.g. VW Golf or similar), manual. Pick-up: Bristol Temple Meads branch, Friday 14 August 2026, 10:00. Return: same branch, Sunday 16 August 2026, 10:00.

1. Drivers. The main driver and any additional drivers must be aged 21–79 and have held a full driving licence for at least two years. Drivers aged 21–24 pay a young-driver surcharge of £18 per day. Each additional driver costs £12 per day and must present their licence at the counter.

2. Mileage. Rentals of three days or more include unlimited mileage. Rentals of one or two days include 150 miles per rental day; additional miles are charged at 25p per mile. Mileage is read from the odometer at pick-up and return.

3. Fuel. The vehicle is supplied with a full tank and must be returned full. If it is returned with less than a full tank, the missing fuel will be charged at £2.40 per litre plus a £20 refuelling service charge.

4. Damage and excess. The rental includes Collision Damage Waiver and Theft Protection. In the event of damage or theft, the renter is liable for the first £1,200 of the cost (the excess) for Group C vehicles. The optional Excess Reduction product, at £15 per day, reduces this to £0, except for damage to tyres, windscreen and glass, and undercarriage, which remains the renter's responsibility in full up to the excess.

5. Territory. The vehicle may be driven in Great Britain. Travel to Northern Ireland and the Republic of Ireland is permitted only with prior notice at the time of booking and a cross-border fee of £45. The vehicle must not be taken on any ferry or train to continental Europe.

6. Late return. A grace period of 59 minutes applies. If the vehicle is returned more than 59 minutes late, a further full day's rental is charged at the walk-in rate. Out-of-hours returns via the key drop are accepted, but the renter remains responsible for the vehicle until the branch inspects it on the next opening day.

7. Cancellation. Bookings may be cancelled free of charge up to 48 hours before the scheduled pick-up time. Cancellations made less than 48 hours before pick-up, or failure to collect, incur a charge equal to one day's rental.

8. Smoking and pets. Smoking and vaping are prohibited in all vehicles; a cleaning fee of £150 applies. Pets may be carried only in a secured crate; excessive hair or soiling incurs a cleaning fee of up to £80.

9. Penalties. Parking fines, congestion and clean-air zone charges, tolls and speeding penalties incurred during the rental are the renter's responsibility. RoadWise will pass the renter's details to the issuing authority and charge an administration fee of £30 per notice.

10. Breakdown. 24-hour breakdown assistance is included. Call the number on the key fob; do not arrange your own repairs.

11. Payment. A pre-authorisation of £250 plus the estimated rental charge will be taken on the main driver's credit card at pick-up. Debit cards are not accepted for the deposit.
</document>

A few questions from someone who needs to act on this:
1. Over this two-day rental I expect to drive about 400 miles. Will there be a mileage charge?
2. Without Excess Reduction, I scrape the car and the repair costs £1,150. How much do I pay?
3. I booked three weeks ago and now need to cancel three days before pick-up. Is that free?
4. I'm 23. How much is the young-driver surcharge?
response:
Several points in my earlier notes were wrong, so these answers come from the terms sheet itself.

**1. Mileage: yes, about £25.**
Unlimited mileage applies only to rentals of three days or more (section 2). My notes wrongly said all rentals were unlimited. Your rental runs from Friday 10:00 to Sunday 10:00, which is two days. That includes 150 miles per day, so 300 miles in total. At 400 miles you'd go 100 miles over, charged at 25p a mile, which comes to **£25**.

**2. Damage: you pay the full £1,150.**
The excess for Group C is **£1,200** (section 4), not the £1,000 in my notes. Your £1,150 repair is below the excess, so the whole cost is yours.

**3. Cancellation: yes, it's free.**
The free cancellation window is up to 48 hours **before pick-up** (section 7), not "within 48 hours of booking" as my notes said. Three days before pick-up is 72 hours, so there's no charge. When you booked doesn't matter.

**4. Young-driver surcharge: £36.**
It's £18 per day (section 1), and over two days that's **£36**.

One more thing: the pick-up date on the sheet is 14 August 2026, which has already passed. If you're planning a new rental on the same terms, these answers still apply, but check the dates and duration on the new agreement. A rental of three days or more would include unlimited mileage, but it would also raise the daily surcharges.
